A posted update's audience can't change. On a draft, `scheduled_for` schedules or reschedules it and `scheduled_for: null` cancels the schedule; posting a scheduled draft now clears it. Once posted, a schedule change returns 422.

post.summary: Make a copy for this cohort
post.description: Copies the shared curriculum, switches the cohort to the copy and moves the cohort's learner data (progress, submissions, release dates and every other content reference) to the copy's ids in one transaction. Learner progress and the cohort's submission windows are compared before and after; any difference rolls back (422 verification_failed). Old ids keep resolving for the cohort's learners. 201 when copied; 200 with already_copied when an earlier request made it, so a client that timed out can repeat the request and gets the same copy. 409 busy when the copy waited more than 5 s on someone else's lock or a statement ran past 30 s (nothing was copied; repeat the request); 409 content_moved when the cohort no longer uses source_curriculum_id (reload). 403 not_allowed; 422 with code copy_not_needed, source_missing, source_archived, copied_before, unassigned_learner_work, media_missing, media_changed, verification_failed or invalid.

409.description: Nothing was copied: busy (repeat the request in a moment) or content_moved (the cohort no longer uses this curriculum; reload).

post.summary: Reply to a help request (staff), or follow up on one (the learner who asked)
post.description: Body: `{ "reply": { "body": string, "resolve": boolean, "client_request_id"?: string } }`. Without `resolve` the request stays active (an open request becomes acknowledged by the replier); with it the request is resolved. The learner is notified once, after the reply commits. `client_request_id` (8–64 letters, digits, `-` or `_`; one per reply attempt, reused on retry) makes a retry safe: if this author already saved a reply with that id on this request, that reply is returned with `replayed: true` and nobody is notified again, even when the first attempt resolved the request. The learner who asked may follow up on their own open or acknowledged request once staff replied (`resolve` is ignored): the reply has `from_student: true`, the status, owner and `staff_response` stay as they were, and the owner (every cohort staff member when nobody owns it) is notified; the learner's response omits staff-only fields. 403 for other roles, or a learner whose course no longer offers instructor help; 404 outside the staff member's cohorts or for another learner's request, 422 for a blank or too-long reply, a malformed client request id, a new reply on a resolved or canceled request, or a learner follow-up before any staff reply.

Class files and private student folders
get.description: Staff (admins, or instructors assigned to the cohort) get every ready class file, including `staff_only` staged files, and `student_folders`: one per active or paused enrollment, even with no files. Students with read access get `class_files` (ready, visible to students, available before any pause) and `my_files` (their own folder, same rules); they never receive `student_folders`. `can_upload_personal` is true only for a student whose enrollment is active and unexpired. 403 outside the viewer's cohorts.

post.summary: Add a link, or start a class file or student folder upload
post.description: With `kind: link` (no storage needed) saves a public https:// link and returns it ready (201 `{ file }`); http, javascript, data and file links, credentials, localhost and private or link-local addresses are refused (422). Otherwise creates a pending file and returns a presigned S3 POST. Omit `student_id` for a class file or link (staff only); pass an enrolled student's id for their private folder. Students may add only to their own folder, only while active, and only with `visibility: students`. Allowed upload types: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text, Markdown, ZIP, PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP3, M4A and MP4, up to 100 MB; active types such as HTML, SVG and scripts are rejected (422). 503 for an upload when storage is not configured. Shares the uploads rate limit.

patch.description: Staff only. Moves every class file and link in `from_folder` to `to_folder` in one statement (student folders are unchanged) and returns how many moved. 422 for a blank source or a blank or longer than 80 character name.

patch.summary: Rename, move, share or stage a file or link
patch.description: Staff may change `title`, `description`, `folder`, `visibility` and a link's `external_url`; a student only `title`, `description`, `folder` and a link's `external_url` on items they added to their own folder, while active. A new link address is checked like a new link and reclassified. Other students' and staff files are 404 to a student.

delete.summary: Delete a file and its stored objects
delete.description: Staff may delete any file in the cohort; a student only files they uploaded to their own folder, and only while active (403 when paused, completed or expired). With `pending_only=true` it abandons an unfinished upload and refuses (422) once the file is published, so retrying after a lost `complete` never removes a published file. 502 when the stored object could not be removed.

post.summary: Publish an uploaded file
post.description: Checks the staged object's type and size, copies it to its published key, and marks the file ready. Repeating it on a ready file returns the file unchanged. 422 when the upload expired or does not match.

get.summary: Short-lived download link
get.description: Returns an uncached presigned URL that downloads as an attachment. Students may download only ready class files visible to students and their own folder (others are 404), only if available before a pause (403), and the link never outlives course access. Pass `version_id` for an earlier version. A paused learner whose current version was published after the pause gets the newest earlier version. Links have no download (422).

parameters.name: version_id
parameters.description: A ready version of this file (from `versions`). Paused learners may read only versions published before their pause (403).

get.summary: Preview a file in the app
get.description: Same access, pause and expiry rules as `download`, and the same optional `version_id`. PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, MP3, M4A and MP4 return a short-lived inline `url` served with the file's allowlisted type; Markdown, text and CSV return up to 512 KB of UTF-8 `text` (with `truncated`), read by the API so no storage CORS is needed; Office files and ZIPs return `download_only` with metadata. Pages, SVGs, scripts and XML are never stored, so never served inline. 503 when a previewable type needs storage that is not configured; 422 for links.

parameters.name: version_id
parameters.description: A ready version of this file (from `versions`). Paused learners may read only versions published before their pause (403).

post.summary: Copy a class file or link into every active student's folder
post.description: Staff only. The source must be a ready class file or link (422 otherwise); links copy without storage, files need it (503). Students who already have a copy are skipped, so running it again reaches only newly enrolled students. Optional body `{ "folder": string }` names the folder for the copies; it defaults to the source's folder.

get.summary: Published versions of a file
get.description: Ready versions, newest first, with `current` marking the one the file shows. Empty until a file gets a second version. Paused learners see only versions published before their pause. Same access rules as `download`.

post.summary: Start uploading a new version
post.description: Staff on any published uploaded file; an active student on a published file they uploaded to their own folder (paused, completed and expired learners get 403). Archives the original upload as version 1 the first time, creates a pending version and returns its presigned S3 POST. Same type and size rules as an upload (422); 422 for links and unpublished files; 503 without storage. Shares the uploads rate limit.

post.summary: Publish an uploaded version
post.description: Checks the staged object's type, size and opening bytes (bound to its etag) like `complete`, copies it to its published key, marks the version ready and makes it the file's current version. Published versions are numbered without gaps. Repeating it on a ready version returns it unchanged. 422 when the upload expired, does not match, or changed while confirming.
